description: This file defines the ClientEntity class in the OAuth2 module, implementing the ClientEntityInterface. It uses traits for common behaviors and provides methods to set and get client name and redirect URI, as well as setting confidentiality status.

classes.name: ClientEntity
classes.description: Implementation of OAuth2 client entity, managing client properties such as name, redirect URI, and confidentiality status.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the client.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for the client.

methods.name: setIsConfidential
methods.description: Sets whether the client is confidential.
